messages:
Sam Warren: Heads-up: we're scheduling the GitHub SSO & service-account token cutover this Tue 09:00 PT. This is the migration that replaces legacy PATs with short-lived OIDC tokens for CI runners. Please read the runbook and confirm any blockers: https://runbook.internal/redwood/sso-oidc-cutover :sparkles:
Jess Li: Thanks — what's the blast radius? Will existing self-hosted runners break if we don't update immediately?
Sam Warren: Good q — short answer: no catastrophic failures. Old PATs will be deprecated but still valid for 48h after the cut. CI jobs that rely on stored PATs in repo secrets will fail once those tokens are revoked. Self-hosted runners need the new config if they authenticate via org-level tokens.
Maria Gomez: Does this impact our Jira/GH linked issue creation via the automation bot?
Sam Warren: Jira integrations that use a GitHub app are unaffected. If you use inline scripts that call GH APIs with PATs (e.g., issue creation from CI), those need to switch to the new `actions/oidc` workflow or use the new `ci-service` service account. Runbook section "migrations/jira-and-automation" has examples.
Noah Patel: For Dedicated customers (redwood-dedicated infra) — do we have service account key rotation steps? I can't have expired creds during maintenance windows.
Sam Warren: We added a Dedicated subsection. TL;DR: Dedicated nodes should pull new tokens from the KMS-backed secrets agent; rollout is automated via the `infra/sa-rotation` playbook. If you manage any on-prem runners, coordinate with infra before Tue.
A J: I'll help triage any jobs that break in dev. Planning a quick preflight run on Monday 16:00 PT with a subset of repos (dev, playground, internal-sdk). Want volunteers to watch logs. :eyes:
Jess Li: I'll join the preflight. Can you paste the exact command we should use to test OIDC token exchange?
Sam Warren: Sure — example test (run on a runner machine):
```
# request token via OIDC (example)
curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"audience":"https://token.redwood.ai","repository":"redwood/internal-sdk"}' \
  https://sts.internal.redwood/get-oidc-token
```
Sam Warren: Also check `gh auth status` and ensure `GITHUB_ACTIONS=true` in the env when testing.
Deploy Bot: deployment #lib-runner-config v1.14.2 started by A J (CI-runner updates). Status: in_progress
A J: preflight invite sent — #eng-platform preflight thread. If anyone has scripts using `GH_TOKEN` or `GITHUB_PAT`, search and open a PR to replace with OIDC flow.
Maria Gomez: Noted. I'll audit `automation/issue-bot` today and post a list.
Noah Patel: If we find repos that can't migrate in time, can we get a short extension window?
Sam Warren: We can grant short extension on a case-by-case basis. Please file a quick ticket in #help with repo name and owner. We want to avoid long tails, but we'll be pragmatic.
Jess Li: Awesome, thanks. See you Monday 16:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Sam Warren: Thanks everyone — I'll post a final checklist and the preflight invite in ~2 hours.
